function mintTree(uint8 species, string memory tokenURI) public payable returns (uint256)

function getTreeData(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (tuple(uint8 species, uint256 plantedAt, uint256 carbonOffset, uint256 lastWatered, uint256 waterCount, uint8 growthStage, string season, uint256 generationSeed))
function getTreesByOwner(address owner) public view returns (uint256[])
event TreeMinted(address indexed owner, uint256 indexed tokenId, uint8 species, uint256 carbonOffset)
event TreeWatered(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed waterer, uint256 waterCount)
event TreeGrown(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint8 newStage)
